title: Rename 'api registry' → 'api endpoints'
description: Rename the 'api registry' sub-branch and all its commands (list, add, update, show, remove) to 'api endpoints'. Also rename the error codes REGISTRY_ENTRY_* → ENDPOINT_* throughout the codebase. Keep 'api registry *' as deprecated aliases. 'endpoints' is more descriptive and less internal-sounding than 'registry'.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1–27 complete. Commands registered as 'api registry list|add|update|show|remove'. Error codes prefixed REGISTRY_ENTRY_. Deprecation infrastructure available.
goal: After this story: 'zapi api endpoints list', 'zapi api endpoints add', 'zapi api endpoints update', 'zapi api endpoints show', 'zapi api endpoints remove' all work. 'zapi api registry *' still works with deprecation warnings. Error codes are now ENDPOINT_*.
scope: Rename the command file: src/ZapiCli/Commands/ApiRegistryCommands.cs → ApiEndpointCommands.cs. Rename all command classes: ApiRegistryListCommand → ApiEndpointListCommand, ApiRegistryAddCommand → ApiEndpointAddCommand, ApiRegistryUpdateCommand → ApiEndpointUpdateCommand, ApiRegistryShowCommand → ApiEndpointShowCommand, ApiRegistryRemoveCommand → ApiEndpointRemoveCommand. Rename Settings classes analogously.
In src/ZapiCli/Program.cs: change the inner api branch AddBranch from 'registry' to 'endpoints'. Register all five endpoint commands under the 'endpoints' branch.

Re-add a deprecated 'registry' sub-branch inside the 'api' branch. Each deprecated shim command calls DeprecationHelper.Warn("api registry <verb>", "api endpoints <verb>") before delegating. Create five deprecated shim classes.

Rename error codes: find all occurrences of REGISTRY_ENTRY_ in the codebase (ErrorCodes.cs, command classes, and any test fixtures) and replace with ENDPOINT_. Common codes to rename: REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND → ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND, REGISTRY_ENTRY_ALREADY_EXISTS → ENDPOINT_ALREADY_EXISTS, REGISTRY_ENTRY_INVALID → ENDPOINT_INVALID, etc. List all occurrences found before renaming.
Do NOT change the --url, --method, --name, --headers flags or output format of any registry/endpoint command.
acceptanceCriteria: 'zapi api endpoints list' returns the list of registered endpoints
'zapi api endpoints add --name myapi --url https://...' adds a new endpoint
'zapi api endpoints update', 'show', 'remove' all work under the new name
'zapi api registry list' still works and prints a deprecation warning
Error codes in stderr envelopes now use ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND (not REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND)
All existing tests pass (update all class name and error code references)
contextForAgent: Read src/ZapiCli/Commands/ApiRegistryCommands.cs to understand all five command classes and their Settings. Read Program.cs to understand the current 'api' branch structure — it currently has 'call' (→ 'request' after story 28) and 'registry'. Search the entire src/ for REGISTRY_ENTRY_ to find all error code occurrences before renaming. Check src/ZapiCli.Core/ErrorCodes.cs (or equivalent) for the error code constants.
